## What this changes

One paragraph. What a reader sees or gets that they did not before.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran it and clicked the thing I built
- [ ] Empty, loading, error, full and overflowing states are handled
- [ ] `/verify` passes, and any new screen has its steps added
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, tests and build are green locally
- [ ] Anything decided is in `docs/product/decisions.md`
- [ ] A screenshot is in `docs/design/screenshots/` if a screen changed
- [ ] Commit messages and copy have no dashes as punctuation
